description: Source code for a Lua bit operations library (lua_bit.c), implementing bitwise operations for Lua 5.1/5.2.

methods.name: barg
methods.description: Converts Lua argument to bit type (UBits).

methods.name: bit_tobit
methods.description: Converts a number to a bit representation.

methods.name: bit_band
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND on multiple arguments.

methods.name: bit_bor
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR on multiple arguments.

methods.name: bit_bxor
methods.description: Performs bitwise XOR on multiple arguments.

methods.name: luaopen_bit
methods.description: Initializes the bit library for Lua.
